_comment: Project-local Claude Code MCP server registration. Auto-loaded when Claude Code starts in this directory; user is prompted once to trust the server, after which 50+ phantom-mesh tools (file_read, file_edit, shell, git_*, content_search, task, subagent, …) are available as mcp__phantom__* tools alongside Claude Code's built-ins. Equivalent of running: claude mcp add phantom $(which phantom) mcp
